description.narrative:
CTP and Caritas Diocese of Malakal (CDoM) suspended humanitarian emergency response activities in Melut/Manyo Counties as result of the outbreak of fighting between the SPLA and SPLA-IO in the areas in April. The suspension was mainly informed by the fact that staff safety and security could not be guaranteed, the beneficiaries had fled the project areas and specifically CDoM staff could not work in the project area base (Melut) due to the ethnic and political implications of the conflict which was now being fought on tribal lines. The suspension of the Manyo Phase II project had a knock-on effect on the Phase III project which was in pipeline, with funds already allocated by Irish Aid, and initially supposed to start in September this year. After the suspension of humanitarian activities, CTP and CDoM started to explore the options of relocating to other locations where there are needy people with unmet needs; particularly focusing initially on preliminary information provided by CDoM, regarding the presence of needy IDPs in Unity state (Mayom County). The preliminary assessment information was obtained from the Catholic Church Parish in Mayom County. Similarly CDoM obtained preliminary assessment information regarding a large number of needy returnees and also information about an anticipated influx (early next year) of more returnees into GPAA. CDoR also initially reported that there were needy IDPs from Jonglei and Unity states; who have settled within host communities in Yirol East County in Lakes state. Therefore it was decided that, one assessment be carried out in Yirol rather than Mayom county, due to logistical and operational considerations, and also to expedite the need to start the Irish funded Phase III project in either Greater Pibor Area or in Yirol East County.
The overarching objective of the assessments conducted by CTP, CDoM and CDoR in Yirol east and GPAA was: To complete a humanitarian programmatic needs assessment in the locations of Lekakudu, Adior, Malek and Pagarau Payams in Yirol East county and Pibor, Lekuangole and Vertet Counties in Greater Pibor Administrative Area and also to do a operations/set up feasibility to identify the prospects and realities of setting up a new CTP/CDoM and/or CTP-CDoR base in either Pibor or Yirol town(s).
